text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Japan Cup, she would have a rematch 
with rivals she previously competed 
against in the Takarazuka Kinen on her 
specialty—a heavy track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she fell into distress upon 
seeing the heavy track conditions. 
Uttering an ominous "future 
prediction"—that after the "GATE," the 
dream would not come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I manage to calm Neo Universe down. Right 
now, we have to focus on this race...!
